generation: Groq initially returned a TPM rate limit at Q10. The failed row was retained and explicitly resumed with token-based pacing. All 78 candidate answers were then generated.
judge_availability: Gemini returned intermittent HTTP 503 capacity errors. Failed HTTP judgments are retained without quality scores and can be explicitly resumed. A read timeout occurred during judging Q26 and stopped that invocation; already saved judgments were retained.
diagnostic_probes: Small probes of Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite and 3.6 Flash also returned 503. Neither model was substituted into the reported experiment. A small Gemini 3.5 health check and a shorter diagnostic rubric succeeded. Diagnostic rubric scores are not included in the experiment.
output_limits: The custom Gemini judge cap was reduced from 2048 to 512 tokens after observing that all completed baseline/candidate judgment outputs were at most 347 tokens. Completed scores were retained; unfinished cases used the tighter ceiling. The official DeepEval sample uses a 1024-token ceiling. Generator settings did not change.
routing_fix: An offline test caught a manufacturer/category substring collision: Northline Mobility matched the Mobility category too early. Manufacturer routing now takes precedence. The earlier catalog retrieval report is retained under a before_routing_fix filename; final catalog retrieval scores were rerun.
checkpoint_migrations: When adding future broad-context projection and correcting routing, existing completed generation request contexts were checked for equality before retaining them. No completed answer was silently relabeled as a new prediction.
cost_scope: Reported costs estimate completed calls with provider-reported token usage. Diagnostic calls and work inside interrupted DeepEval metrics are not fully accounted for and may add cost. No API invoice or complete billing total is claimed.
references: Supplied reference answers and AI-prepared mappings/rubrics remain pending human review. No human feedback has been fabricated.
native_explanations: After repeated capacity failures during native metric summary-reason calls, remaining non-GEval metrics use include_reason=False and save intermediate verdict details instead. Scoring algorithms are unchanged. Completed earlier scores and reasons are retained; G-Eval still produces a reason with its score.
native_request_checkpoints: Successful internal DeepEval responses are cached by model, prompt, schema and generation settings within each run and stage. Explicit resumes reuse these successful calls. No automatic retry or error-catching handler was added. Cached costs represent the original completed calls. Fresh runs use separate request caches.
native_output_limit_correction: The native judge returned no parsed structured result while extracting truths for broad-catalog Q78 at the 1024-token cap. The native cap was restored to 4096 for remaining requests, with a clear assertion on missing parsed output. Existing completed metric scores were preserved. The custom rubric cap remains 512.
identical_input_reuse: Generator-isolation Q1 has exactly the same question, answer, reference and context as candidate Q1. Its two completed native faithfulness/relevance measurements were reused from the pipeline report and labeled reused_from. No fresh judge call or extra cost is claimed for those two reused measurements.
